strategy.name: qqq_dual_raw_stochrsi_intraday_timing
strategy.description: Use raw unsmoothed Stochastic RSI with periods 42 and 100 as a joint all-in/all-out QQQ timing signal. Compare three paired semantics: joint oversold/overbought level states, joint rolling extrema, and recovery/reversal crossings. Each next-session trigger price is solved only from completed data through the prior close. An opening gap beyond the trigger fills at Open; otherwise the trigger fills only when it lies on the directed Open-to-Close path. The market chart displays Close only.
strategy.buy_rule: LEVEL: flat and both provisional StochRSI(42) and StochRSI(100) become < 0.2 on a downward Open-to-Close path. EXTREME: flat and both become 0 on a downward path. CROSS: flat, both completed prior values are < 0.2, and both provisional values become >= 0.2 on an upward path.
strategy.sell_rule: LEVEL: long and both provisional StochRSI(42) and StochRSI(100) become > 0.8 on an upward Open-to-Close path. EXTREME: long and both become 1 on an upward path. CROSS: long, both completed prior values are > 0.8, and both provisional values become <= 0.8 on a downward path.
strategy.signal_time: Trigger prices and crossing eligibility are frozen before each regular session from adjusted daily data completed through the prior close.
strategy.execution_time: Same regular session: Open when it has already gapped through the predeclared boundary; otherwise the exact boundary price only when the directed Open-to-Close segment reaches it. High and Low are not used to infer a touch.
strategy.positioning: Long-only; 0% or 100% QQQ; fractional shares; no leverage, shorting, pyramiding, or cash interest; at most one order per session.
strategy.initial_position: flat for all timing strategies and the SMA200 baseline; Buy & Hold enters at the first analysis-session Open
strategy.indicator_definition: For each period p, Wilder RSI(p) is normalized by the rolling p-value minimum and maximum of that same RSI series; a zero range maps to 0.5; no K or D smoothing.

plain_language.summary: 比较两个不同速度的 StochRSI 同时确认超买超卖时，三种进出场解释能否改善 QQQ 的持有体验。
plain_language.buy: 两个周期都进入低位时买入；三种版本分别在进入低位、同时创滚动低点或从低位向上恢复时行动。
plain_language.sell: 两个周期都进入高位时卖出；三种版本分别在进入高位、同时创滚动高点或从高位向下回落时行动。
plain_language.execution: 每天开盘前用前一日及更早数据算好触发价；跳空越过就按开盘价成交，否则只有开盘到收盘的价格路径碰到触发价才按该价成交。
plain_language.position: 策略只在满仓 QQQ 与持有现金之间切换，并与买入持有、SMA200 正负3%择时和报告中的等额定投情景比较。

benchmark: Buy & Hold QQQ from the first analysis-session Open, plus a separate all-in/all-out dynamic SMA200 -3%/+3% timing baseline under the same Open-to-Close trigger model

reporting.reuse_review: Reuse v5 unchanged: its human-language strategy flow, Close market panel, selectable equity series, visible-range rebasing, equal-installment DCA, collapsed technical appendix, and print rules cover this fixed-case comparison.
reporting.scenario_layer: The equal-installment DCA control is browser-only, uses the visible-range Buy & Hold starting equity as total budget, invests at evenly spaced sessions, leaves undeployed cash non-interest-bearing, and does not mutate formal ledgers.

research.hypothesis: Joint 42/100-day StochRSI confirmation may reduce false single-horizon timing signals, and recovery/reversal crossings may behave differently from persistent level or exact-extreme states.
research.primary_metric: CAGR and Sharpe for each fixed strategy, interpreted with maximum drawdown, exposure, order count, and both 0/5 bps costs
research.selection_rule: Run and report all three predeclared paired semantics without selecting or retuning parameters; compare each with Buy & Hold and SMA200 +/-3% timing.
research.validation_plan: Treat 2020-2026 as an exploratory comparison. Any promising semantics must be frozen before a separate earlier-history, later-forward, or cross-asset test.
research.promotion_criteria: Both ledgers reconcile, all engineering/report gates pass, and a later predeclared validation retains an economically useful CAGR/Sharpe/drawdown tradeoff after 5 bps without changing periods or thresholds.
research.rejection_conditions: Do not promote from this run alone; reject direct promotion for very few completed trades, cost fragility, materially worse return without meaningful risk improvement, ambiguous trigger reconstruction, or any ledger/report validation failure.
